# Philemon Mulunda — 3D Garage Portfolio

> Machine-readable overview for AI agents. Full structured content is in `src/data/aiSiteManifest.ts`, injected into the built page as `#portfolio-ai-manifest`, and logged to the browser console as `[portfolio-ai-manifest]`.

## What this site is

philemonmulunda.com is an interactive 3D garage portfolio built with React and Three.js. Each object in the scene represents a project, job, school, or personal story. Visitors explore by hovering and clicking 3D objects to open detail panels.

## Author

Philemon Weiming Mulunda — double major in Computer Science and Physics at St. Lawrence University.
